scientific_integrity.claim_domain: Finite nontrivial words of q_t(x)=x+t x(1-x) for t in [-1,1], and regular cycles of finite piecewise selections
limitations: Discontinuity-hitting and endpoint cycles excluded from piecewise repulsion claim
Word-product resonance is for the unrestricted word composition; a given switching itinerary also requires all intermediate states to lie in their designated cells
Published 2019 repulsion theorem for its one-cut subfamily credited as prior work
No general entropy, mixing, or classification of all boundary orbits

title: Word-product resonance and universal repulsion in switched quadratic population maps
